_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: After a compaction the recovery also resends org-layer cards, using what is left of the budget after the global and project batches; TECH.md and the TECH/ pages are now in English, with the Traditional Chinese text kept as *.zh-TW.md copies that link to each other; the notice-once config keys are renamed (notice_once under coordination, parallel_agents and aidocs, aidocs.advisory_once, self_iteration.oscillation_once, codex_companion.soft_gate.handoff_review_guarded) and the old v6 names are still read, with one stderr line asking for the rename; the handoff extension no longer writes automatic handoff stubs on compaction or session end, so a handoff note is written only when someone runs /handoff; index tables escape "|" in caption cells everywhere and the hook fallback decodes it; every subprocess call passes the no-window flags, and two checks that were always red are fixed
